label: heating DualSP daily plan; not compressor command; not school occupancy

layers.A_school_occupancy: external calendar constraint; agent must not move it
layers.B_bas_occupied_unoccupied_mode: BAS occ/unocc mode around the school day
layers.C_heating_setpoint_schedule: six 96-step DualSP heating setpoints the agent may choose inside a safe envelope
layers.D_equipment_availability: plant remains available for setback and freeze protection
layers.E_fan_compressor_operation: thermostatic cycling under BAS/thermostat safety; never direct compressor control

heating_setpoint_start_step.note: 05:00-10:00 DualSP occupied start; cannot move school occupancy

heating_setpoint_end_step.note: 96 means midnight/end of day and must not wrap to 0

continuous_conditioning.eligible_when: occupied_heating_setpoint_f equals unoccupied_heating_setpoint_f, or explicit flag
